g.text: Page-local surfaces · inherits InputGroup, Button, Switch, Badge, Panel/SubCard and spacing tokens
mL per cycle · safe range 5–100 mL
Validation is text-first; border color reinforces but does not carry meaning alone.
Numeric value + fixed unit inside the control
Compact control radius 10 · control height 40–48 · unit remains readable at mobile width.
Field action stays attached; primary action remains explicit
Action labels name the operation; do not use icon-only controls for required recovery.
Single choice · active state uses fill + label, not color alone
44px+ touch target where interactive; horizontal overflow allowed before ambiguous wrapping.
Small finite mode switch; one active segment
Keyboard focus must remain visible; labels never shrink below readability.
Compact multi-value summary with optional remove affordance
Chips summarize; full editable meaning remains available in the parent editor.
Allow this flow to issue its configured commands.
Switch label describes user-visible behavior, not implementation details.
Nested configuration surface; indigo is reserved for config semantics
Override active · inherited recipe remains visible
Page-local config grammar; do not promote until an independent non-automation consumer exists.
Stable inspector frame for selected node forms
Then → DOSE · validation stays beside the affected field.
Desktop: inspector can remain side-by-side. Mobile: stack node identity before fields; preserve validation and actions.
Pump A cannot run while tank level is below the configured minimum.
Critical meaning uses icon + explicit text + semantic red. Never color alone.
Below 768px: cards stack; inspector identity comes before fields; long chip rows scroll horizontally; labels never shrink below readability.
Default · focus · filled · disabled · invalid · warning · pending are expressed through text, icon, border/fill, and control affordance together.
These remain page-local automation surfaces. Extract to global UI only after independent reuse outside automation.
React owns behavior · accessibility · runtime state
